name: TN-02
label: Safe R

key_factors: Strong Republican district with a PVI of R+17
Incumbent Tim Burchett running with a large fundraising edge
Prediction markets price Democratic chances near 5%

model.rationale: The fundamentals point firmly to Burchett: a heavily Republican seat, incumbency, and a fundraising advantage of roughly six-to-one over Barnett. Markets price a Democratic win at only about 5%, consistent with a Safe R call.
model.watch: A major scandal or an unusually strong Democratic wave environment could narrow the margin, though a seat this red is unlikely to flip.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Tim Burchett seeks another term in this Knoxville-area district, which leans Republican by about seventeen points. He has raised roughly $2.4 million and holds nearly $1 million on hand, while Democrat Michaela Barnett has raised about $400,000 with modest cash remaining. No outside groups are active in the race.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the contest, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and money. Prediction markets give Democrats only a small chance of an upset, and the seat's partisan lean makes a competitive race unlikely barring extraordinary developments.
